description: Implementation of the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, managing a cache of compressed certificates for QUIC protocol, including methods for insertion, retrieval, and hashing of certificate data.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache for storing compressed certificates associated with uncompressed certificate data, with methods for managing cache entries.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::UncompressedCerts
classes.description: Represents uncompressed certificate data including the chain and client cached cert hashes.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::CachedCerts
classes.description: Represents cached compressed certificate data, including the chain, hashes, and compressed certificate.

methods.name: hash_combine
methods.description: Inline helper function to combine a 64-bit seed with a 64-bit value, based on Boost's hash_combine.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::GetCompressedCert
methods.description: Retrieves a cached compressed certificate matching the given uncompressed certificate data.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new compressed certificate into the cache associated with the given uncompressed certificate data.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::ComputeUncompressedCertsHash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the uncompressed certificate data to be used as cache key.
